newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia raises internal coffee price to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Colombia raises internal coffee price to new highs.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 2 Reuter - Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation raised the country's internal coffee price Friday to a new all-time high of 387,625 pesos per 125-kg load, a federation spokesman said.
The new price, up 3.64 percent from 374,000 pesos per 125-kg load set on April 25, was based on an average trading price of $2.29 per pound of Colombian coffee in New York over the last 10 days.

The internal coffee price has been raised 11 times and cut just twice since Jan. 31, following the introduction of a new sliding scale formula to calculate payments to Colombian growers based on international prices.
